questions.question: Consider this security situation: a consultant checks weaknesses only under an agreed engagement. Which technical label MOST accurately applies?

options.A: Ethical hacking
options.B: White-hat hacker
options.C: Black-hat hacker
options.D: Gray-hat researcher

questions.question: For White-hat hacker, which recommendation or interpretation is MOST defensible?
